newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan State Oil up ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan State Oil up ahead of results.

text.p: State-run Pakistan State Oil (PSO) rose 5.0 rupees, or 1.59 percent, to 320 rupees on Wednesday ahead of first-half results, dealers said.
PSO's board is due to meet on Thursday and is likely to announce results for the first half ending December 31.
A turnover of 16,200 shares of the blue chip had been recorded at the Karachi bourse by noon.
"Expectations of higher profits and an overall better performance of the oil marketing sector has pushed PSO rates up," Manocher Jamal, chief dealer at Taurus Securities, said.
PSO commands 76 percent of Pakistan's oil products distribution market, which is worth an estimated 100 billion rupees a year.
